mapper.select: SELECT FROM shop_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM shop_order WHERE uid = #{uid} AND IFNULL(is_del, 0) = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, real_name AS realName, user_address AS userAddress, total_price AS totalPrice, pay_price AS payPrice, pay_time AS payTime, pay_type AS payType, paid, status, create_time AS createTime, CASE WHEN IFNULL(pink_id, 0) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN IFNULL(seckill_id, 0) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN IFNULL(bargain_id, 0) > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS orderType FROM shop_order
AND status = #{dto.status}
AND order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.orderId}, '%')
AND real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.realName}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, o.order_id AS orderNo, c.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.image AS productImage, p.product_info AS productInfo, p.price AS productPrice, c.product_score AS productScore, c.comment AS comment, c.pic AS pic, c.create_time AS createTime FROM shop_product_comment c LEFT JOIN shop_product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN shop_order o ON c.oid = o.id WHERE c.uid = #{uid} AND IFNULL(c.is_del, 0) = 0
AND ( p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.comment LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
